sources.title: PDF InitialresultsoftheDigitalConsciousnessModel
sources.snippet: The Digital Consciousness Model (DCM) is a first attempt to assess the evidence for consciousness in AI systems in a systematic, probabilistic way. It provides a shared framework for comparing different AIs and biological organisms, and for tracking how the evidence changes over time as AI develops. Instead of adopting a single theory of consciousness, it incorporates a range of leading ...

sources.title: Are LLMs Conscious? What the Digital Consciousness Model Found in 2026
sources.snippet: The Digital Consciousness Model's 2026 results evaluated LLMs probabilistically across nine theories. Evidence is against consciousness, not decisive.
